LESSON: MASS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.2: Mass

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Mass. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

MASS Week 8 Lesson 5 Measuring mass in kilograms The kilogram (kg) is used for measuring mass. A shopkeeper measures the mass of sugar, rice and flour in kilograms.

Activity 1 Activity 2 Make 1 kg masses of Using the beam sand or soil using a balance and two beam balance 1-kg masses, guide learners to measure 2 kg of 1 kg beans.

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Mass means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Mass.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Mass
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3
